text: Setup requires only adding a single tracking tag/snippet
quote: Implementation = add a Tag. That’s it. That’s the entire setup.

text: Server-to-server event ingestion via a documented HTTP API
quote: You can use HTTP API to send data to Jitsu. This is useful if you want to send data from your backend.

text: Functions let you filter, transform, and enrich events before they reach the destination
quote: Functions are designed to process data in Jitsu before it is sent to the destination... Filter... Transform... Enrich

text: Anonymous and identified user activity is automatically merged into one profile once identity is known
quote: Once the user identity is known, Jitsu automatically amends all previous records associated with this user based on anonymous cookie-based id.

text: JavaScript/React SDK is Segment-API compatible for web event collection
quote: Jitsu javascript integration is 100% compatible with Segment API.

text: Can receive a webhook feed from Segment and deliver it to your DB in real time
quote: Set up a webhook destination in Segment and send data to Jitsu and get it into your DB in real-time.

text: Delivers data to the warehouse in sub-second time, with optional batching
quote: Sub-second speed of data delivery to your warehouse. Optional batching is also supported

text: Buffers events in Kafka during warehouse downtime and delivers once it's back
quote: Put your data warehouse in a maintenance mode? Jitsu will keep your data in a Kafka and deliver it once the warehouse is back online

text: Automatically deduplicates repeated event sends
quote: Send same data as many times as you want. Jitsu will deduplicate it for you

text: Automatically creates tables and columns in the warehouse based on incoming data
quote: Jitsu will automatically create tables and columns in your warehouse based on the data you send

text: Profile Builder generates customer profiles from identify-event traits
quote: Profile Builder generates profiles based on the `traits` object in `identify` events.

text: Custom JavaScript logic can generate profiles using up to a year of historical event data
quote: You can also define custom logic for profile generation using a JavaScript function, allowing you to leverage up to a year’s worth of user events data.

text: jitsu-cli manages workspace config (destinations, streams, connections) and the Functions dev workflow
quote: `jitsu-cli` is the command-line interface for Jitsu. It manages workspace configuration objects (destinations, streams, connections, …) and runs the Functions dev workflow.

text: CLI can scaffold a TypeScript function project and deploy it to the workspace
quote: `jitsu-cli init` scaffolds a TypeScript project with tests, and `jitsu-cli deploy` ships it to your workspace.

text: Can be self-hosted on Kubernetes via an official Helm chart
quote: Run Jitsu yourself on Kubernetes with Helm, fully under your control.

text: A zero-config development Helm chart deploys the full architecture to Minikube
quote: Development Helm chart: deploy the full architecture to Minikube with zero configuration.

text: Failed events go to a dead-letter queue and can be replayed via a reprocessing worker
quote: Dead-letter queue with a reprocessing worker: failed events can be replayed instead of lost.

text: SOC2-oriented audit log with activity alerts, plus named API tokens that support expiration
quote: Audit log (SOC2-oriented) with account-activity alerts, plus named user API tokens with expiration.

text: Delivery logs/records are emitted as OpenTelemetry OTLP so they can feed Datadog, Grafana, New Relic, Elastic, etc.
quote: Records are delivered as OpenTelemetry (OTLP) log records over HTTP, so they work with Datadog, Grafana Cloud, New Relic, Elastic, or any OpenTelemetry Collector.

text: Runs an MCP server so AI agents can create destinations, wire streams, inspect Live Events, and edit Functions directly
quote: Jitsu runs an MCP server, so AI agents can manage your pipeline directly: create destinations, wire up streams, inspect Live Events, and edit Functions.

text: Supports personal API key auth for headless/CI environments where browser login isn't possible
quote: In CI and other headless environments the browser flow can't run. There you authenticate with a personal API key instead

text: Positions the data warehouse as the single source of truth, optimized for fast delivery into it
quote: Make your data warehouse the single source of truth for your data.

text: Ships dozens of documented destination integrations with streamed or micro-batched delivery per destination
quote: Delivery to destinations — ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Postgres, S3, GCS, and dozens of SaaS tools, streamed or micro-batched depending on what the destination prefers.

text: Connector syncs pull data from third-party sources into the warehouse via Airbyte-compatible connectors
quote: Connector syncs — pull data *into* your warehouse from third-party sources (Airbyte-compatible connectors).

text: Customer data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS)
quote: All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit via TLS.

text: Jitsu is SOC 2 compliant
quote: Jitsu is SOC 2 compliant, demonstrating our commitment to maintaining the highest standards of security and data protection.

text: Can add a plugin to send a copy of existing tracked data to Jitsu without changing frontend code, for gradual migration
quote: No need to change your frontend code. Just add a plugin that sends copy of your data to Jitsu. In this mode, you'll be able to migrate to Jitsu gradually.

text: Functions can expose a warehouse API (ctx.getWarehouse) to query your data warehouse directly from function code
quote: `ctx.getWarehouse` - warehouse API to query your data warehouses

text: Live Events data can be exported near real-time to your own monitoring stack
quote: Everything you can see in Live Events — function logs, warehouse batch statuses, streaming delivery results, and dead-lettered events — can now be exported to your own monitoring stack in near real time.

text: Includes a built-in functions debugger/editor to test functions against sample data
quote: Jitsu comes with a functions debugger/editor that allows to run function on a sample data

text: Full-featured deployment runs functions/profile builders as dedicated servers and connector syncs as Kubernetes CronJobs
quote: A feature-complete Jitsu deployment requires a Kubernetes cluster: functions and profile builders run in dedicated function-server deployments managed by the Jitsu operator, and connector syncs run as Kubernetes CronJobs.

text: Stored event data can be queried directly with SQL for analysis
quote:
select * from events where
  context_page_path = '/signup' and
  timestamp > now() - interval '1 day'

text: DPA and SCC documents are available for data-processing/compliance needs
quote: You can access DPA (Data Processing Agreement) + SCC (Standard Contractual Clause) using this link

text: Event routing can be controlled by not connecting a source to a destination or by using a Function to filter events
quote: You can control which events become active by choosing not to connect a source to a destination or by using a Jitsu Function to filter out unwanted events before they are sent.
